THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
061
Behind the image
01 / Golden Hour
REFERENCE 4564.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 004
Art direction: Late-afternoon warmth, natural facial expression, soft background, shallow depth of
field. Keep the urban setting understated.
Photorealistic vertical editorial selfie of an original adult woman with shoulder-length honey
blonde hair in loose waves, wearing a beige trench coat, a dark top, and delicate layered gold
necklaces. City street at golden hour, softly blurred cream facades, trees and bicycles, warm direct
amber sunlight, casual framing at arm's length, expressive natural skin texture, vintage film grain,
no writing or logos.
02 / Quiet Beauty
REFERENCE 4570.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 005
Art direction: Luminous white background, delicate hair movement, soft shadow boundaries,
precise hand posing.
Photorealistic vertical close beauty editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with long
straight black hair and a few fine strands moving across her face. Bare shoulders, one hand
resting across the opposite shoulder, simple silver ring, soft muted rose lips, near-white seamless
backdrop, delicate diffused cool daylight, airy desaturated blue gray color grading, fine skin detail,
calm direct gaze, tasteful jewelry campaign photography, no text.
